in_arabic.name: عزيفة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث مشتق من عزف، يعني المتغنية أو المغنية
in_arabic.long_meaning: عزيفة هو اسم علم مؤنث في اللغة العربية، مشتق من الفعل عزف الذي يعني التغني أو الغناء. يعتبر هذا الاسم ذا أصول عربية قديمة، وقد ورد في بعض المراجع اللغوية العربية. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في بعض الثقافات العربية للإشارة إلى المرأة التي تتمتع بصوت جميل أو التي تحب الغناء.

in_urdu.name: عزیفہ
in_urdu.meaning: عزف سے ماخوذ، گانے والی یا موسیقی سے محبت کرنے والی
in_urdu.long_meaning: عزیفہ ایک مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے الفعل عزف سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے گانا یا تغنی۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے مابین مقبول ہے، خاص طور پر اردوگو بولنے والے ممالک میں۔ اس کا تعلق موسیقی اور فن سے ہے، اور یہ ان خوبصورت اور سریلی آواز کی مالک خواتین کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو موسیقی سے پیار کرتی ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: उज़्ज़ैफ़ा
in_hindi.meaning: उज़्ज़ैफ़ा का अर्थ है गायिका या संगीत प्रेमी
in_hindi.long_meaning: उज़्ज़ैफ़ा एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है जो भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रचलित है। यह नाम अरबी मूल का है और 'उज़्ज़ैफ़ा' का अर्थ है गायिका या वह महिला जो संगीत से प्रेम करती है। यह नाम उन महिलाओं के लिए चुना जाता है जिनकी आवाज़ मधुर होती है और जो संगीत के प्रति रुचि रखती हैं।

in_english.name: Uzzaifa
in_english.meaning: A melodic or musical name, signifying a singer or music lover
in_english.long_meaning: Uzzaifa is a beautiful and melodious name of Arabic origin. It is derived from the Arabic root 'عزف' (azf), which means 'to play a musical instrument' or 'to sing'. This name signifies a person who loves music or is a skilled singer. In Islamic tradition, names are chosen for their meanings and connotations, and Uzzaifa is considered a lovely and harmonious name. It reflects the importance of artistic expression and musical appreciation in Islamic culture.

data.cultural_impact: The name Uzzaifa adds a sense of security and protection to those who bear it. In Islamic culture, the idea of having a strong guardian or protector is significant because it symbolizes strength, bravery, and the ability to shield those who are vulnerable. This cultural impact is reflected in various aspects of Islamic society, such as the tradition of having a designated protector for pilgrims making their way to Mecca, or the hadiths discussing the importance of seeking refuge in Allah and His Messenger (peace be upon him).
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Uzzaifa is deeply rooted in the concept of tawakkul (total reliance and trust) in Allah. As the name Uzzaifa means "the one who is always there to protect," it is a reminder that ultimately, it is Allah who shields and guards us from harm. Muslims believe that seeking Allah's protection and relying on Him is crucial in navigating the challenges of life and achieving peace and happiness. Moreover, the name Uzzaifa can also be seen as a reminder of the idea of being a protector or guardian to others, embodying the noble character trait of al-Khafidh (the one who protects) mentioned in Islamic literature. By living up to this name, one can hope to gain spiritual rewards and blessings, as well as contribute positively to their community and the world at large.
